footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.4% to $392M in 2025. Operating income fell 0.3% to $163M, a 41.5% margin.
Net income rose 12.9% to $123M, or $3.77 per share. Operating cash flow was $111M and free cash flow $109M, versus $162M; Okeanis returned $70.7M through dividends.
sources: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
